summary: Make MemoryStorage writes atomic (all-or-nothing) and keep query cache consistent with committed data, matching JSONStorage behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.update(delete('tmp')) is called and raises KeyError

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.remove(Query().tmp.exists()) is called and raises KeyError on the second document
acceptance_criteria.then: db.all() returns the original two documents (unchanged)

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}] and a prior search db.search(Query().tmp.exists()) that returned [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.update(delete('tmp')) is called and raises KeyError

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a'}]
acceptance_criteria.then: db.all() returns [{'name': 'b'}] and subsequent searches reflect the change

acceptance_criteria.when: imported in a Python 3.8+ environment with no extra packages
acceptance_criteria.then: import succeeds and all existing TinyDB tests pass

assumptions.assumption: MemoryStorage.write(data) receives the complete document list each call; atomicity can be implemented by snapshotting the list before mutation and restoring on exception
assumptions.default_used: Conservative default based on TinyDB storage pattern

assumptions.assumption: Query cache invalidation occurs only on successful write (matching JSONStorage behaviour)
assumptions.default_used: Invalidate cache after successful write; leave cache untouched on failed write
